description: Three independent sample-and-hold units, each polyphonic, each with its own output level trimmer

params.text: Scales what that unit captures, from silence at the bottom to the full input at the top

inputs.text: A rising edge makes that unit take a new sample; it reads high above 0.7V

outputs.text: The last sample that unit took, held until the next trigger

notes: the channel count of each unit comes from its own signal jack, so the three can run at different widths
an output stays at 0V until its unit has been triggered at least once

inputs.1:
high above 0.7V · stepped · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
